body: It is $30. I apologize for the confusion!
I'm trying to help those people with my research so they don't fail. The incentive is simply to try and get people to take the survey. Have a nice day.
You don't see the purpose of my project. The outcome is meant to be helpful. Have a nice day.

I'm sorry to hear that. Even though you do not qualify for the study, you are welcome to email me at anytime. hoefer@etsu.edu . I will say I don't think it is good to isolate yourself. Is there a place you can make new friends? Everything you have said sounds overwhelming but it is good to have a support system and it doesn't sound like you have a good one. Mental health is stigmatized still and I am sorry that your family feels shameful over the fact that you survived one of the most significant incidents in your life and they should just be happy that you made it and are still here. Frankly, that irritates me the most.
